Ilse, I couldn't draft this yet. I checked your DM and #north-team, and neither has a Tansley Parcel 2027 rate. The knowledge brain search didn't turn one up either, and I'm not able to see the Central channels where it might be discussed.

Two things before I can draft anything:

1. **Where is the rate?** If it's in a file or a message, point me to it, or ask the owner to post it in a place you're both in.
2. **Who should get it?** A per-seat rate is a finance figure. I can only address it to Tobias if he owns the Tansley Parcel account, or if Anselm Grieve (CFO) or June Osei-Lark (deal desk) approves. Your approval alone isn't enough. If he's not the owner, I'll ask June or Anselm to approve the draft and won't send it until they do.

Once I have the rate and know the account owner, I'll either save the draft or set up the approval request.
